The '''''Rightful Dominion''''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that was owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]].

==History==
The ''Dominion'' was designed and built by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and its construction was completed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Riboga kept it in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kemix]], where he ran a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mining operation.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[For Every Action: Counterstrike|''Counterstrike'']], it is possible for the player characters to activate the ''Rightful Dominion''{{'s}} self-destruct mechanism, allowing them to destroy the ship.
